title: Weather, Not Climate
subtitle: Emotional context dynamics in transformer KV-cache geometry: contrast effects, uncertainty scars, and dose-dependent decay
abstract: Emotion read from single-turn KV keys does not cumulatively accumulate across conversation turns (the single-turn result this builds on was corrected in October 2026: a story-emotion decode from KV keys at 12.3x chance (40.9%), not W_K and not user state. It is not significantly above a text (TF-IDF) baseline (reproduced at 0.410 vs 0.370, Holm p = 0.071), and its margin depends on a residualization fitted on each test fold (0.348 when fitted on the training fold). The described method is not above text (0.358 vs 0.382). Valence AUROC 0.992 beats text (Holm p = 0.006) but is n=300 and arousal-confounded). Instead, emotional context shows contrast dynamics (overshoot at tone shifts), residual uncertainty scars, and dose-dependent decay. System prompts set emotional climate; conversation history provides weather with contrast at fronts.
